ana: quick heads-up — ran into an odd SDK UX bug with Generator.Stream + context cancel + auth rotation. small repro below. :thinking:

ana: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
client := redwood.NewClient(tokenProvider.Get())
gen := client.Generator("gpt-lite").Stream(ctx, Prompt("hi"))

go func() { time.Sleep(80*time.Millisecond); cancel() }()
// background rotates token periodically
go func() { for { time.Sleep(150*time.Millisecond); tokenProvider.Rotate(); client.AuthRefresh() } }()
for _ = range gen { }
```

tom: stack shows goroutines blocked in retry/handshake after cancel, leaking handles.

celine: is this the same race we saw in resume flow? seems related to handshake retry not reading from ctx.

jon: short-term: add explicit Close() on stream iterator and document ownership. long-term: ensure per-stream handshake ctx that is canceled on Close/Drain.

ana: ok i'll open a small PR with failing unit test + fast stress loop and add Close() as a compatibility mitigation. will also add a metric for active streams.

ci-bot: queued build for ana/stream-close-mitigate (draft)

tom: thanks — once PR is up i can take a look at the handshake codepath.

celine: if you need sampleapp edits emily and i can help add an example showing Close() usage.

ana: appreciated, i'll tag you both in the PR. :pray:
